messages:
Morgan (infra): Heads-up — planning a rolling restart for the 'zephyr' rack in us-west2 this Sunday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Reason: NIC microcode + BIOS micro-updates that address intermittent packet drops and a thermal sensor miscalibration. Expect brief node soft-restarts, not full power cycles.
Anika (sre): Copy. What's the expected capacity delta and blast radius?
Morgan (infra): Estimated capacity hit ~10-12% while nodes are drained and rejoined. We'll do a controlled node-by-node softcycle (drain -> reboot -> health-check -> uncordon). 1 node every 90s steady cadence, parallelism 3.
Lee (oncall): 10% is ok for the window if we warmbackfill. Do we have warm spare nodes seeded with KV/prefix cache?
Dan (scheduler): Yes — plan is to pre-warm 8 standby GPUs in the same region with prefix cache seeding overnight. After each node rejoin we'll run a small hotpath traffic soak on the canary pool. Command for seeding: `./ops/seed_cache --pool zephyr-warm --prefixes=common --concurrency=4`.
Sally (support): Please craft a short customer note for any tenants with pinned capacity. We should proactively message those with Dedicated commitments in us-west2.
Morgan (infra): Will do. Tentative customer blurb: "Planned maintenance in us-west2 may cause transient latency spikes and minor capacity throttling between 02:00-04:00 UTC. No data loss. Contact support for reservation concerns." Share in #customer-success and status page.
Anika (sre): I want a canary window first — start with 1 node (canary) then 5% traffic shifted for 10m, then ramp. If canary fails, automatic rollback: scheduler will stop further reboots and we fall back to older NIC firmware image.
Dan (scheduler): Canary rollout plan encoded in the job: `jobs/zephyr/roll-restart.yaml` — uses canary_count:1, canary_traffic:0.05, health_checks: [p95-latency < 150ms, error-rate < 0.5%].
Morgan (infra): We'll also set a temporary routing policy to avoid routing latency-sensitive traffic to nodes with < 5m uptime. Routing flag: `route_avoid_recent_boot=true`.
Lee (oncall): Add an alert: if pooled free GPUs < 6 for > 5m, paging oncall. Also watch for sudden KV cache miss rate > 8% for 2 consecutive 1m windows.
Anika (sre): Agree. Runbook link (preflight + rollback): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/zephyr-softcycle. Steps include: ack page -> pause rollout -> trigger `ops/rollback_firmware zephyr` -> rehydrate caches from snapshot.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: "zephyr maintenance starting in 24h" (auto-post to #eng-infra and #oncall).
Sally (support): I'll draft the status page entry and a support template for pinned customers. Ping me final blurb here before publish.
Morgan (infra): Cost note — warmbackfill increases short-term egress/capacity usage; estimated incremental cost ~$1.8k for the window (GPU hours + storage IO). Finance ok'd as part of maintenance ops budget.
Lee (oncall): Thx. Also coordinate with networking: NIC microcode requires small MTU sanity check post-reboot. @networking-team please verify MTU delta < 2% on canary.
Anika (sre): If we hit a regression in p95 latency vs baseline > 30ms for canary, we'll auto-stop and run a debug capture: `tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/zephyr-canary.pcap` and attach to incident.
Morgan (infra): Ops timeline: 01:00 UTC — pre-warm caches; 01:50 — final smoke tests; 02:00 — start canary node reboot; 02:15 — evaluate; 02:20 — start rolling with parallelism=3; finish by ~03:50 including cool-down.
Dan (scheduler): I'll push the job schedule and set `max_parallel=3` in the deployment YAML.
Sally (support): Published draft to #customer-success-private, awaiting approvals from product & legal.
Lee (oncall): Approved from oncall side. I'll be on standby 01:45-04:30 UTC.
Anika (sre): I'll own the rollback gates and health check dashboard.
Morgan (infra): Great. Final ask: react with :thumbsup: if you acknowledge and I'll flip the infra-bot reminder to 2h and 15m as well.
Dan (scheduler): :thumbsup:
Sally (support): :thumbsup:
Lee (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll join the call if canary trips.
Anika (sre): :thumbsup: prepping alert thresholds now.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: `zephyr-roll-restart-v1` at 6060606060, lint OK, dry-run passed.
Morgan (infra): Thanks team — will post the final customer blurb and runbook link later today. Anything else?
Lee (oncall): Nothing on my end. See you on Sunday. :coffee:
